name: prospectloom
description: Find leads around the clock, research each company from its own website, and send a few personal, human-sounding emails every day from your own mailbox. Free stack: OpenStreetMap, Groq, any SMTP/IMAP mailbox.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
